Meetings, Agendas & Video Archives

Unless otherwise announced, Chicago Plan Commission meetings are held on the third Thursday of every month starting at 10 a.m. at City Hall, 121 N. LaSalle St., City Council chambers.

* Note: The October Plan Commission Hearing will be held at 10:00 a.m. in City Hall, 121 N. LaSalle Street, 11th Floor, Room 1103. 

Meetings can be accessed by livestream the day of the meeting.
